name: Save Text
description: Save incoming text, documents, or chunks to one file or multiple files and return artifact metadata.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Destination file path. Use Browse to pick a Save As filename. In separate-files mode, this becomes the base name for generated chunks.

parameters.name: separate_files
parameters.description: When true, save one file per document/chunk item using baseName_00001, baseName_00002, ... in the target folder.

parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: File extension used for generated files.
